# Menu 275 (physics ON/OFF frame conversion) on the selected bone keys of
# chain8_ik.pmx with swing600.vmd: OFF, then ON again.
load model chain8_ik.pmx
load vmd swing600.vmd
select all bone
physics frames off
save pmm physics-off.pmm
select all bone
save vmd physics-off.vmd
physics frames on
save pmm physics-on.pmm
select all bone
save vmd physics-on.vmd
